correction_reason: Strengthens the Phase C baseline to freeze the reviewer-required project.debate.consensus_matrix integration boundary for TICKET-HLITE-003.
rationale: Freeze a black-box Horo v3 consensus matrix interface integration baseline for TICKET-HLITE-003. Baseline parent is current HEAD b0aa8ec8c98965686d013108ede8878ce696c677. Red evidence command python3 -m pytest tests/test_horo_lite_unified_reading.py -k test_horo_v3_consensus_arbitration_and_hitl_triggers -v exited actual 1 and expected 1 with fingerprint ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'project.debate' because project.debate.consensus_matrix is absent and consensus arbitration remains local inside project/core/annual_timing_engine.py. The frozen test imports project.debate.consensus_matrix, requires a callable public annual/monthly arbitration interface through arbitrate_monthly_consensus or ConsensusMatrix with a documented arbitration method, and requires calculate_annual_timing(request) to return consensus_metadata.consensus_matrix_source == project.debate.consensus_matrix while preserving Phase C assertions for consensus_score in 0-1, arbitration status, 12 arbitrated monthly claim records, fail-closed QUEUED_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW for low consensus, tradition conflict, force_human_review=True, and uncertain birth time, and NOT_REQUIRED only when no trigger applies.
